arguments.sql:
SELECT f."Low Grade", s.GSserved, COUNT(*) AS schools
FROM main.schools AS s
JOIN main.frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.EILCode = 'HS' AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Provision 2'
GROUP BY f."Low Grade", s.GSserved

SELECT s.School, s.City
FROM main.schools AS s
JOIN main.frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.EILCode = 'HS'
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Provision 2'
  AND CAST(f."Low Grade" AS INTEGER) > 9
ORDER BY s.School;
